radar-view.description: Competency profile per class on shared axes — overlaid polygons with an integrated legend, focusable vertices and per-vertex tooltips.

examples.note: Toggle series in the legend and select vertices in the log below.
examples.keyboardNote: Vertices are keyboard-focusable: Tab to a vertex, arrows to move across axes, Enter to select.

manySeries.note: Ten axes with six classes: use the filter legend to isolate a class and compare profiles without leaving the chart.

empty.note: With no visible series, the chart hides the SVG and renders a localized empty message instead of an empty web.

installation.note: Install the package and import the standalone radar component.

props.note: Inputs, possible values and defaults. vertexSelect emits the selected vertex; seriesToggle emits the toggled series id.

radar-view.title: Radar
